en: A multi-view color postcard showing four photographs of traditional red wooden houses in a rocky, forested landscape with views over water. The buildings include timber cottages and a larger two-storey red house with white trim and a tiled roof. The scenes look rural and summery with blue skies, birch and pine trees, and footpaths and roads leading between the houses. In the center, cursive text in Swedish identifies the location as Gammelgården in Bengtsfors.
